column1: # SPLIT-RECONSTRUCTION grid: 3 modes x 2 delta targets x 2 bases, + ratio ladders.
# User direction 2026-09-20: "launch all three modes on M03 and M06", with phase 2.
# WHY. F-recon1: smooth_l1(pred, target) is ~99.8% CONTROL RECONSTRUCTION on M03, so the
# perturbation is supervised by ~0.2% of that term's gradient. The split weights the two
# TWO ORTHOGONAL AXES, both verified end-to-end on the real streaming config (3 epochs each):
#   recon_split_mode = where the GENE-SPACE CONTROL comes from. The streaming path serves 512-d
#   pool embeddings, so there is no per-cell gene-space control unless one is materialised.
#     raw        per-cell control expression, via a 4.74 GB CPU pool (F-recon2)
#     cmean      the LINE control mean, already in _stream_v2_state -- free
#   recon_delta_target = what the DELTA regresses against. THIS IS THE PHASE-2 AXIS.
#     cell        this row's single cell, whose noise is 3-70x the effect size  (phase 1)
#     group_mean  the denoised group mean, as dcos and delta_mag already use    (phase 2)
# ⚠️ `delta_only` is NOT phase 2. It is phase 2's DELTA term with L_ctrl dropped. Phase 2
# PROPER keeps BOTH terms and denoises only the delta = cmean|raw + group_mean (G04/G09).
# MEASURED BALANCES (UNWEIGHTED terms, ep1 -> ep3, real config). Each combination imposes a
# DIFFERENT balance, which is why they are separate arms and not variants of one result:
#   raw   + cell        L_ctrl 32.5% -> 32.0%   FLAT -- the cell's own noise never becomes
#                                               learnable, so a fixed weight = a fixed balance
#   cmean + cell        L_ctrl 23.1% ->  6.4%   decays 4.4x; self-balances toward the delta
# WHY THE LADDERS DIFFER PER MODE, rather than {1,3,10,30} everywhere:
#   raw/cell   -- balance is STABLE, so the ladder does what a ladder is for. Full {1,3,10,30}.
#   cmean/cell -- already 94% delta unaided; {1,3,10} tests pushing PAST self-balancing.
#   delta_only -- w_delta is not a ratio (there is no L_ctrl); it scales the WHOLE recon term
#   G25/G26    -- SCALE-MATCHED on raw from its MEASURED converged balance (L_ctrl 0.004457,
#                 L_delta 0.009468): equal contribution with TOTAL recon held fixed. NOT a
#                 point on the (1,k) line -- the ladder lets total recon grow with w_delta,
#                 this holds it, isolating the internal split from the recon-vs-dcos balance.
# Everything else is arm s313: adjacency_map, batch 2048, lr 1e-3, decoder_lr 1e-3,
# cosine_loss_weight 0.5, film multiplicative_only, fh 256, mean-free, 30 epochs, seed 42.
# `mae` is an ERROR: LOWER IS BETTER.
# PRE-REGISTERED. mae falls below 0.0212 with pearson_delta held -> F-recon1 is right that mae
# was immovable because every prior lever acted on the perturbation while mae is dominated by
# control reconstruction. mae flat across all 26 -> F-recon1's hypothesis is wrong and mae is
# bounded by something else. group_mean beats cell -> single-cell noise was the binding
# constraint and phase 2 is the answer. M03 and M06 disagree -> setup-dependence again
# (F-loss9, F-latent4), and no split result generalises across bases.
